product_metadata.title: Dazzlewings Telescopic Sink Storage Rack Holder with 2 Sponge, Adjustable Telescopic 2-in-1 Sink Storage Rack Holder with Dishcloth for Home Kitchen(Blue)
features: ✅【Adjustable Length/Telescopic Design】The telescopic shelf has a simple and easy-to-use design that is suitable for most sinks. It is recommended for use with sinks ranging from 24cm to 40cm in length.
✅【Mark-Free Installation】No drilling is required, making installation, disassembly, and cleaning convenient. It won't damage the sink during installation and won't leave any marks after disassembly.
✅【High-Quality】The telescopic rack has good load-bearing capacity and is not easily deformed. The polypropylene material is thicker and rust-free.
✅【Quick Drainage】The telescopic rack features an open hollow design and evenly spaced drainage holes at the bottom, allowing water to flow out quickly and preventing accumulation.

✅【Ideal Tool for the Kitchen】The telescopic rack does not take up too much space, but in addition to the drainage rack basket for sponges, cleaning brushes, etc., it also has a towel rack on top that can be used to dry towels and other fabrics without producing odors.
